bump_reason: Patch per Continuous Evolution Guide section 2 (Label Spec Patch = sentinel outlier quarantine rule fix). Adds a deterministic quarantine rule that removes physically-impossible label endpoints; no label definition, horizon, or event semantics changed.
grain: one released Gold-B inspection interval (row = interval); label describes the NEXT inspection interval on the same wheelset equipment

governance.point_in_time_rule: Labels use only source facts with business time AFTER the row's interval_end_timestamp (strictly future-dated; no leakage).
governance.row_eligibility: A row is eligible only if a chronologically next inspection interval exists on the same wheelset_equipment_id; otherwise the label is unavailable (NA) and the row is dropped from supervised splits.
governance.freeze_rule: Labels are generated once per dataset version by this specification; they are never overwritten or regenerated silently.

quarantine_rule.rule: Quarantine a supervised row if wsmDia1 of interval_end_measurement_id OR next_interval_end_measurement_id is outside [1000.0, 1100.0] mm.
quarantine_rule.rationale: A railway wheel diameter outside [1000, 1100] mm is physically impossible in service (domain constants: condemning 1016 mm, new 1096 mm; tolerance absorbs measurement noise and in-service wheels near the condemning limit). Such rows carry measurement-garbage labels (e.g. |delta| up to ~1090 mm from bronze wsmDia1 values of 0 or >1e6 mm) that inflate regression RMSE and poison the training target distribution.
quarantine_rule.audit_basis: models/experiments/v1.2/sentinel_audit_findings.md — 65 rows (0.03%: train 55, val 9, test 1) quarantined; rule subsumes |next_interval_dia_delta_mm| > 100 (63 rows) with 100% recall.

labels.name: Next-interval diameter change
labels.definition: Diameter change (interval_end - interval_start, mm, side 1) of the chronologically next inspection interval on the same wheelset equipment.
labels.positive_definition: negative value = material loss (diameter decreased); positive = measurement variance, turning-at-end residual or replacement artefact
labels.generation_sql: NEXT interval end_wsmDia1 - NEXT interval start_wsmDia1, where NEXT interval = MIN(interval_start_timestamp) over intervals with same wheelset_equipment_id AND interval_start_timestamp > this_row.interval_end_timestamp; row quarantined if either endpoint wsmDia1 not in [1000, 1100] mm
labels.known_limitations: Not a pure wear measure: the next interval may contain a turning event or replacement (both cut diameter). Unit confirmation for wsmDia pending; sign convention end-start confirmed as negative-at-turning (Q5). Sentinel rows with physically-impossible endpoints are removed by the quarantine rule (1.0.1); residual magnitudes are <= ~80 mm.

labels.name: Turning in next interval
labels.definition: 1 if the end measurement of the next inspection interval on the same wheelset equipment carries turning_indicator_raw == 1 (wsmturning1).
labels.positive_definition: a reprofiling/turning event was recorded at the next measurement (owner-confirmed wsmturning=1, Q1)
labels.generation_sql: CAST(NEXT interval turning_indicator_raw == 1 AS INT), where NEXT interval as defined for next_interval_dia_delta_mm
labels.known_limitations: Imbalanced (positive rate ~2% of measurements). The wsmturning flag may undercount events by a small residual (~0.6% of pairs, Q2), so the label is not a perfect true turning count. LwrTurningType is NOT used (post-turning outcome, Q3).

labels.name: Material-loss event in next interval
labels.definition: 1 if the next inspection interval shows a material-removal signature: diameter delta <= -2.0 mm OR root delta <= -1.0 mm (side 1).
labels.positive_definition: material-removal event in the next interval (turning cut, replacement cut, skid/flat) beyond heuristic threshold
labels.generation_sql: CAST((NEXT interval end_wsmDia1 - NEXT interval start_wsmDia1) <= -2.0 OR (NEXT interval end_wsmRoot1 - NEXT interval start_wsmRoot1) <= -1.0 AS INT)
labels.known_limitations: Thresholds are heuristic (turning median -2.8 mm dia; replacement cut avg -2.14 mm dia; root-drop>1.0 buckets), to be sanity-checked in Dataset Validation. Conflates turning, replacement and genuine wear into one event class.

labels.name: Days to next turning (survival)
labels.definition: Calendar days from this interval's end to the next wsmturning1 == 1 measurement on the same wheelset equipment. Right-censored (censored_flag = 1) when no turning is observed within the data horizon for that equipment.
labels.prediction_horizon: time-to-event, uncensored observation window = data end
labels.positive_definition: event = turning; censored_flag distinguishes observed (0) from right-censored (1) rows
labels.generation_sql: MIN(wsmUpdatedOn) over measurements with same wsmEquipmentId AND wsmturning1 == 1 AND wsmUpdatedOn > this_row.interval_end_timestamp, minus this_row.interval_end_timestamp; NULL => censored at data horizon
labels.known_limitations: Right-censoring at the observation window end biases short horizons. Same undercount residual as next_interval_turning_flag. Requires survival-aware evaluation (Harrell C-index, Kaplan-Meier strata), not plain regression RMSE.
